name: amaterasu-proxmox
description: Proxmox lab helper CLI and Proxmox API mock

scripts.venv:init: uv venv && uv pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.txt
scripts.mock: cd mock && pnpm install && pnpm start
scripts.docker:build: export PROJECT=$(jq -r .name package.json) VERSION=$(jq -r .version package.json) && docker buildx build --pull --build-arg GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) -t infernokun/$PROJECT:$VERSION -t infernokun/$PROJECT:latest .
